_comment: Curated leaderboard references for tdcommons datasets. PRECEDENCE: prefer the POLARIS HUB (polarishub.io, owner 'tdcommons') over TDC's own leaderboard (which can contain errors); fall back to TDC's leaderboard only where Polaris has no entry. Each entry's 'provider' records which leaderboard the score came from ('polaris' or 'tdc'). Rank-1 mean scores; treat as references, not ground truth (leaderboards are dynamic). Each task keeps its official ranking metric — AUROC for most, AUPRC for the imbalanced CYP inhibition/substrate tasks (note CYP3A4_Substrate uses AUROC). 'split' is the scaffold split the score is reported on. NOTE: TDC's only single-molecule leaderboard IS the ADMET Benchmark Group, which Polaris mirrors, so there are currently no 'tdc'-provider fallbacks to add — datasets outside the ADMET Benchmark Group (e.g. hiv, cyp1a2_veith, cyp2c19_veith, carcinogens_lagunin, skin_reaction, the SARS-CoV-2 / Butkiewicz HTS sets) are on no leaderboard and stay blank. Keyed by tdcommons dataset slug.
